# AORMS

AORMS stands for Accelerated Operational Resources Management System — a **product suite** for AEC consulting firms and project management consultancies.

AORMS is NOT contractor ERP and NOT a full Primavera/MSP replacement. Practice managers handle communications; technical work (estimation, BBS, programme, drafting) stays on the desktop. Firm portals publish updates online. **aorms.in** is marketing and blog (soft launch — sign-in and Windows installers coming soon). Licensing is **open source for now**.

Suite map:
- **AStudio** / **AConsulting** — practice managers (architecture / engineering)
- **AQC Estimation** · **AQC BBS** · **AQC Project Management (AProc)** — technical desktop installers sharing bbs_engine
- **AADT** — 2D drafting · **ShilpiDB** — geometry store
- **EOMS** — external knowledge bank · **ESTI** — internal AI on desktop managers

Suite home: https://aorms.in/
Blog: https://aorms.in/blog
Downloads (coming soon): https://aorms.in/downloads

Key articles:
- https://aorms.in/blog/why-aorms-suite-matters

Product notes:
- Technical work and AI stay local on desktop apps
- Firm portals show published data only (not draft CAD / BOQ lines)
- Pure neumorphism UI (`@hcw/ui-kit`) on marketing + portals

Website:
https://aorms.in
